operative_context: The system shall ensure availability changes are applied immediately when relevant rental lifecycle events or availability controls are updated.
The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.
## 4.2.3 The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information.
Availability queries must reflect the latest rent and item status information at query time.
The system shall ensure availability status reflects the current lifecycle state of rent records.
The system shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur.
exceptions: Availability restrictions take precedence over normal availability.
Maintenance periods block rental activity and make items appear non-rentable.
conflicts_or_obsolete: Earlier discussion suggested using a single fallback delay after certain rental events, but current availability rules do not rely on uniform timing assumptions.
